The update workflow now verifies TOOLING_UPDATE_TOKEN before using it. An expired personal access token previously failed the whole update at checkout with a raw git error that named neither the token nor the secret, because the old fallback only handled a missing secret and an expired token is still a non-empty value. Expired, misscoped or unverifiable tokens now fall back to the built-in token so the update still applies everything except workflow files, and the run summary explains exactly which token failed and how to rotate it.
